title: Denis Taxi · Bienvenidos · Welcome · 336
style: acoustic latino, gentle 90 BPM, gentle marimba, soft cajón, warm Spanish guitar, warm female Spanish vocal and warm male English vocal alternating, friendly tourist welcome tone, San Juan del Sur ambience, light shaker, no rap, no edm, no auto-tune, polished, family friendly, short jingle length
lyrics:
[Intro — soft marimba]
Bienvenidos a Nicaragua… welcome to Nicaragua.

[Verse 1 — ES female / EN male alternating]
(ES) Soy Denis, su taxi de confianza.
(EN) I am Denis, your trusted taxi driver.
(ES) Hablo inglés, lo llevo seguro.
(EN) I speak English, I take you safely.
(ES) Día y noche, sin descansar.
(EN) Day and night, without rest.

[Chorus]
Taxi Denis. Cinco cero cinco. Cinco ocho cero siete. Tres uno cuatro seis.
Five oh five. Five eight zero seven. Three one four six.
WhatsApp — Shop Friend English House Sitting Pay For Coffee.
Just message. I am here.

[Outro]
Tres tres seis. Three three six. Welcome home.
